icons.name: bell
icons.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The integrated top hanger is shortened by 0.5 unit (from 2.3 to 1.8 units above its shoulder junction) so it reads as a compact nub. The full drawing is then translated upward by 0.25 unit to keep opposite vertical margins balanced: centerline bounds y=2.75..21.25, visible Regular bounds y=1.9..22.1. Straight walls, shoulders, lower lip and clapper proportions are retained. No doubled seams. Owner-approved source; Outline geometry retained through the Filled clapper correction.

review.note: Owner approved Bell after the solid Filled clapper correction. Both styles reviewed at source proportions and Regular 1.70; the Filled clapper is a solid part with no U-shaped recess.

icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm. The left and right shoulders have explicit 3-unit horizontal ledges at y=6.8 (x=5..8 and x=16..19), with a narrower raised housing to keep both straight spans visible. The indicator is a zero-length segment centered at 17.9,9.5 with round caps, forming a solid circular dot whose diameter follows the stroke. This avoids the hollow-ring rendering of a tiny stroked circle under non-scaling preview strokes at high zoom. The circular lens is centered at 12,13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Camera Outline and Filled at source proportions.

icons.name: folder
icons.description: A horizontal rounded folder with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Owner-approved horizontal Folder. Single rounded outer contour with a straight front-panel edge at y=10.9. Bounds x=3..21, y=4.3..19.7; default stroke is 1.7, with visible left/right padding 2.15 and top/bottom 3.45. The approved X=100%, Y=110% geometry is baked into the path coordinates, preserving constant stroke width and the existing part names.

review.note: Owner approved both styles. Y scaling and constant stroke/gap have been baked into the source; the approved shape is now 100% in the Lab.

icons.name: heart
icons.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The lower silhouette is a slim V with only a slight outward convex bow. Mirrored quadratic flanks depart subtly from straight diagonals and meet a compact rounded tip. Tangents align through the side transitions and tip without inward inflections. The established upper lobes and notch are retained. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Heart Outline and Filled after the head alignment and centered-grid review. The reviewed Lab preview used X/Y=95%; these local preview settings are recorded without changing the source geometry.

icons.name: moon
icons.description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The crescent preserves the recognizable lunar silhouette as an intentional circular exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. Two radius-8 circles separated by vector 4,-4 define the exterior and concavity; a single closed contour avoids doubled edges. The drawing is translated so its native centerline bounds are x/y=4.35424869..19.64575131; Regular 1.70 gives equal opposite visible margins of 3.50424869. Rounded stroke joins soften both horns without decorative stars or extra details. Static draft awaiting owner review.

icons.name: search
icons.description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The circular lens is an intentional silhouette exception. A single 45-degree handle meets the circle at its centerline, with a rounded free end. Combined centerline bounds x/y=3.3..20.7 balance the grid. Owner-approved source. Outline-only icon by owner direction; no Filled variant.

review.note: Owner approved Search Outline; Filled is intentionally omitted by owner direction.

icons.name: settings
icons.description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Six original radial teeth use straight faces with individually rounded transitions. The recognizable gear is a silhouette exception to the rounded rectangle baseline. Opposite teeth are constructed in symmetric pairs about 12,12; the circular hub remains circular. Owner-approved source. The owner-selected 30-degree clockwise orientation is baked into all source coordinates about 12,12 for both styles. This orientation is now native rotation 0 degrees; no SVG or preview transform is needed.

review.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled at the previous 30-degree preview orientation. At the owner's request, that orientation is now baked into both original SVGs and is the native 0-degree baseline. Exterior and hub alignment are preserved at Regular 1.70.

icons.name: sun
icons.description: A clear circular sun with eight short, evenly spaced rays.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The circular disc preserves the real celestial silhouette and is an intentional exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. At the owner request, the disc radius increases from 4.25 to 5.1 and the eight radial centerlines shorten from 2 to 1 unit, running from radius 8.2 to 9.2. The disc remains centered at 12,12. Round caps and Regular 1.70 stroke are retained, giving equal visible margins of 1.95 units and a minimum disc-to-ray gap of 1.4 units. Overall dimensions are unchanged. Native proportions are the reference; static draft awaiting owner review.
